title: Samosa Caucus set to regain heft as Democrats win control of US House
description:
The Samosa caucus is set to regain its heft on Capitol Hill with Democrats wresting control of the US House of Representatives, and newcomers Pia Dandiya and Amish Shah set to join four Indian American lawmakers.
The Samosa Caucus, the informal group of Indian American lawmakers, was set to shrink to four with Congressman Shri Thanedar losing the Democratic primary from Michigan and Raja Krishnamoorthi making an unsuccessful bid to contest the Senate poll from Illinois.
Indian-American Ami Bera, Ro Khanna, Suhas Subramanyam and Pramila Jayapal have been re-elected to the US House of Representatives, while Dandiya made a strong debut by winning the newly carved out 22nd congressional district in Florida, a Republican stronghold.
Shah, an emergency room doctor, was on course to win Arizona's first Congressional district bagging 52.6 per cent votes against 45.4 polled by Republican Jay Feely. The results were yet to be declared as 85 per cent votes have been counted.
